say: Monday night, in Saint-Denis.
Stop the presses.

beats.headline:
Four in
fourteen
beats.deck: Belgium led for 42 minutes. Then Zidane's substitutes scored four times in the last fourteen.
beats.note: All four goals came from the bench.
say: Tomorrow's front page: four-one to France.
Four goals in fourteen minutes, and every one of them came off the bench.

beats.label: How it happened
beats.title: From 0–1 to 4–1
say: Belgium struck first. Lukébakio, after thirty-five minutes, with his left foot from twenty-two metres.
On Sunday, Zidane promised changes. On the hour, he made them: Olise and Cherki. Then Doué.
Doué levelled on seventy-seven. Cherki made it two, four minutes later.
And Olise scored twice, right at the end.

beats.label: The bench
beats.title:
Three subs.
Four goals.
beats.deck: Zidane said there would be changes. He just waited for the hour to make them.
say: Three substitutes. Four goals.
Doué had been on the pitch for five minutes. Cherki and Olise, for less than half an hour.

beats.title: The numbers
beats.note: Belgium's keeper made five saves. France kept coming.
say: Twenty-four shots to five. Nine on target to two.
Belgium's keeper made five saves, and France just kept coming.
This morning, we wrote: a narrow France win, with few goals.
France won it. Narrow, it was not.
Half right.

items.text: Calafiori and Pio Esposito, both on at 55 minutes, scored after Şimşir's equaliser. Italy go second.
Gyökeres scored after 13 minutes: seven Nations League games in a row with a goal.
Yaremchuk headed Ukraine level on 83. Two minutes later, Csinger won it for Hungary.

say: Elsewhere tonight. In Bologna, two more substitutes, Calafiori and Pio Esposito, scored as Italy beat Türkiye three-one. Called it.
In Bucharest, Viktor Gyökeres scored again: that's seven Nations League games in a row. Sweden win, one-nil. Called it.
And in Trnava, Hungary beat Ukraine two-one, with the winner on eighty-five minutes. We had a Ukrainian edge. Wrong.

beats.title: Group 1
beats.sub: France three points clear; Italy climb above Belgium.
points: Only the top two reach the March quarter-finals
say: So France are three points clear at the top, and Italy climb above Belgium, into second.
Two matchdays to go.
And only the top two reach the quarter-finals.
That's tomorrow's paper, tonight. Follow for the next edition.
